window: [t0-60,t0+60); pre < t0; post >= t0; PCAP capture seconds

E_numeric_relative_change.formula: max over channels with valid pre and post observations: abs(mean(post)-mean(pre))/max(abs(mean(pre)),floor)

E_post_missing.formula: channels without any valid post observation / all statically eligible mapped channels in that family

E_state_changed_fraction: fraction with last(pre) != last(post), among reported-state channels observed validly in both halves; null if none
E_quality: Exclude null/nonfinite or any quality-flagged observations from features; retain them in evidence. No forward filling. BASE/NONE scales require no multiplier.
N_formulas_in_order: log1p(post ASDU 45..51 and COT=7 count); response, not proof of positive confirmation or execution
log1p(post TCP RST packet count on port 2404)
maximum gap between sorted fresh post APDU times including t0 and t0+60, divided by 60; no APDU => 1
log1p(unique IP endpoint count in post TCP port-2404 packets)
TCP_policy: Exact same-range same-byte TCP retransmissions are not new messages/process values. Same-start different-length or different-byte payloads remain distinct captured APDUs and process observations, with conflicts counted in private build audit. Neither first-seen nor later bytes are assumed accepted by the receiver. All E features summarize observed reports, not reconstructed endpoint state or independent physical truth. IP fragmentation and partial APDUs fail closed. This is a capture-observation decoder, not TCP receiver reconstruction; only exact segment retransmissions are deduplicated.
provenance: Each feature row points to SHA256 of full label-free EvidenceEpisode plus versioned extraction recipe; recomputation after source removal is mandatory.
